messages:
From: Julia Park <julia.park@apexcare.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot packaging & pricing — quick numbers?

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the low-latency inferencing looks very promising for our clinical summarization flow. Procurement looped me in to get explicit packaging/pricing so we can scope a 6–8 week pilot before a broader rollout.

We have two usage profiles we care about:
- Batch summarization (daily backfill, ~1.2M tokens/day)
- Interactive summarization (live clinician UI, peaks at ~1k reqs/min)

Primary asks:
1) What plan would you recommend for a pilot that lets us test both profiles?
2) Can you outline upgrade/downgrade paths if we need to move from a pilot to a production tier?
3) What pilot discount or credit can Redwood offer — we have internal pricing thresholds and need to present a short-term cost model.

If you can send a 1-page proposal and a rough SOW we can share with procurement that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Julia Park
Sr. PM, Platform & AI — ApexCare
procurement@apexcare.com

P.S. We may need SOC2 artefacts; procurement will request separately if we move forward.
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@apexcare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot packaging & pricing — quick numbers?

Julia — thanks for the note and great meeting yesterday. Quick, pragmatic answers below and I attached a short proposal PDF (ApexCare-Proposal-v1.pdf) with the numbers.

Recommended pilot composition (to cover both profiles):
- Pilot tier: "Compact+Throughput" mix — Compact model provisioning for interactive UI (low-latency instances with prefix caching) plus a throughput burst pool for daily backfill jobs.
- Baseline capacity: 2 interactive vNodes (sized for 1k rps bursts), 1 throughput pool with 8k token/sec sustained throughput.
- Duration: 8 weeks recommended; can shorten to 6 weeks if procurement needs faster signoff.

Upgrade/downgrade path (short):
- Upgrade: Swap to a Dedicated Capacity contract (reserved nodes); we offer an automatic credit for any committed months that covers pilot consumption up to the month of conversion.
- Downgrade: Convert throughput to on-demand metered pool; interactive nodes can be scaled down and enter a grace burst window.

Pilot commercial offer:
- Standard pilot discount: 15% off published rates for the pilot term.
- If ApexCare commits to a 6-month post-pilot minimum (Reserved Dedicated capacity), we can extend to an 18% pilot discount and provide a one-time 500k token credit to offset migration costs.

Next steps:
1) If the 18%/500k uplift is attractive, Ben/Finance will need to rubber-stamp the concession (I cc'd Ben and Priyom).
2) We can turn the one-page into a DocuSign and start procurement review.

Attaching: ApexCare-Proposal-v1.pdf (proposal summary + SOW stub).

Happy to hop on a 30-min pricing call today or tomorrow.

— Vivek
